openapi.title: OpenAPI Spec
openapi.description: OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 specification of the target API, as a JSON/YAML object or as JSON/YAML text. Alternatively set OpenAPI Spec URL; an inline spec takes precedence.

openapi_url.title: OpenAPI Spec URL
openapi_url.description: URL of the target API's OpenAPI (3.x) or Swagger 2.0 document, JSON or YAML. Fetched anonymously by the bridge; Extra Headers and the External Service credential are sent only if the operator enables OPENAPI_FETCH_SEND_AUTH. Used only when no inline OpenAPI Spec is set.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: The base URL of the target API. All tool invocations will be made relative to this URL.

extra_headers.title: Extra Headers
extra_headers.description: Extra headers to inject on API call

external_service.title: External Service
external_service.description: Name of an entry in this application's external_services registry to source live auth credentials from
